_description: Gate 5 regression fixture — URL liveness and blocklist check. Four representative URLs: one valid manufacturer, one news-domain, one marketplace product listing, one likely-dead URL. Check flags: 1=blocklisted, 2=dead (4xx/5xx liveness), 3=<3 suppliers per BOM row.

entries.notes: Valid — DigiKey is a well-known electronic component distributor. URL is a category page, not a specific product listing. Should pass blocklist and liveness.
Blocklisted — URL is on a news subdomain (news.*). Gate 5 should flag this before even attempting the HEAD request. Check flag 1 = blocklisted.
Blocklisted — Alibaba product-detail listing. This is the BESS demo failure pattern (memory: forgeos_pdf_and_supplier_gotchas). Check flag 1 = blocklisted.
Dead URL — domain does not exist, HEAD and GET both return network error or DNS failure. Check flag 2 = dead (liveness failure).

bom_row_check._description: A BOM row with only 2 valid suppliers triggers check flag 3 (< 3 suppliers per row). No is_proprietary exception available on the parts table as of Phase 2.
bom_row_check.notes: Check flag 3 = fewer than 3 valid suppliers for this BOM row. Gate 5 should FAIL with severity P1.
